newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 13-day repo tender at 3 pct rate.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 13-day repo tender at 3 pct rate.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuesday it was setting a tender for 13-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed rate of three percent.
Funds will be credited to accounts Wednesday and the securities have to be repurchased on May 27.
A 61 billion mark facility set also at a fixed three percent rate expires on Wednesday.
A 14-day facility set last week carried a three percent interest rate, the rate that has prevailed since August 1996.
